description: Probability diagnostics do not generally represent the documented final sampling distribution.
trigger: Enable probability or top-token reporting while using distribution-changing sampling, including DefaultSampler, or allowed/blocked-token constraints.
expected_behavior: Report chosen-token and top-token probabilities after applicable sampling transformations and constraints.
actual_behavior: receive_logits normalizes its logits argument rather than the transformed sampler state. DefaultSampler's min-p and temperature changes are absent; cloned token constraints are absent too, so forbidden tokens can appear in reported top candidates. The active generator caller passes these diagnostics directly to streaming buffers without correction.

finding.description: Optional diagnostics still need not represent the documented final sampling probabilities.
finding.trigger: Enable probability or top-token reporting with CustomSampler while supplying allowed_tokens or blocked_tokens that exclude a token with finite input logits.
finding.expected_behavior: Final sampling probabilities reflect the constraints, excluding forbidden candidates.
finding.actual_behavior: CustomSampler clones logits before applying these constraints. Job.receive_logits subsequently normalizes its original logits, so excluded tokens retain reported probability and can appear in top-token output. The sole active direct caller forwards those diagnostics unchanged into receive_sample's streaming buffers.
